title: Live structure canvas
summary: One zoomable canvas for hosts, VMs, containers and links with combinable layers (performance and network, storage, backup, construction sites and warnings, health, version, drift), motion bound to causes, live deltas batched to one update a second, and persona assessments drawn on top of facts as schema-validated view specifications. Measured on 500 nodes and 2,000 links: own Canvas 2D engine recommended over PixiJS and Cytoscape.js; uPlot recommended as the hosting area's chart library. Backup inventory checked against the code: five of six must-keep locations have no off-host copy. Ten slices, first the canvas with semantic zoom and the Performance and network layer on live data.

coveredElsewhere.slice: Extended structure facts: observed hosts, machine kind and nesting, placement file, performance and network facts per node, data locations with backup coverage, facts for warnings, live deltas
Instance deploy records (deploy steps on a node)
Deployment dashboard charts on the chart library of D2
Persona scheduling, admission, budget ledger, feeds and magazine

openDecisions.title: Canvas renderer
openDecisions.question: Which renderer draws the structure canvas, and every canvas of the Studio?

options.A: Own Canvas 2D engine, ported to a lazy Angular component

openDecisions.rationale: Meets the frame budget on CPU raster, cheapest particles and tokens, smallest chunk; PixiJS stays the measured fallback behind the same interfaces.

openDecisions.title: Chart library
openDecisions.question: Which single chart library draws the hosting area's charts (AGT-3950)?
openDecisions.rationale: Smallest chunk and fastest live update for time series and bars; other forms as small SVG components, not a second library.

openDecisions.title: 2D, 2.5D or 3D
openDecisions.question: Which projection does the canvas use?

options.A: 2D by default with a 2.5D overview switch

openDecisions.rationale: 2D reads best at every level; 2.5D is the playful overview on the same engine at little cost; 3D adds cost and no fact.

openDecisions.title: Default layers
openDecisions.question: Which layers are on when a user opens the canvas for the first time?

options.A: Performance and network, Health, Construction sites; remembered per user
options.C: The layers the selected persona suggests

openDecisions.rationale: Answers 'is it live and is anything broken' at once; missing backups are marked in every combination anyway.

openDecisions.title: Motion level
openDecisions.question: How much moves by default?

options.A: Lively: flow particles and event motion while visible, Off with reduced motion
options.B: Calm: event motion only, flow as width

openDecisions.rationale: The owner asked for movement; every motion has a cause, runs at most at 30 fps and stops when hidden.

openDecisions.title: Replace the Structure view
openDecisions.question: Does the canvas replace the current Structure view?

options.A: Yes, after parity (outline, deep links, project scope, Version, Drift); classic view one more release
options.C: Keep the current view; canvas as a separate Live tab

openDecisions.rationale: Two drawings of the same machines drift apart; parity first keeps every link working.

openDecisions.title: Backup target the Backup layer checks
openDecisions.question: Which off-host target should the backup job use and the Backup layer check against?

options.A: SFTP to the home lab's storage, a second site the owner controls
options.B: S3-compatible bucket at another provider, with versioning

openDecisions.rationale: Off-host and off-site with no new account; supported by the backup feature; a bucket can follow as a second copy.

openDecisions.title: Key custody
openDecisions.question: Where are the backup key and the secret store key escrowed?

options.A: Two separate password manager entries, attested by fingerprint

openDecisions.rationale: The restore runbook requires the keys apart from the backups and from each other; attestation lets the view show the date.

openDecisions.title: Roles that assess
openDecisions.question: Which personas assess the installation for the canvas?
openDecisions.rationale: Backup, credentials and escrow belong to the warden; hosts, links and capacity to the reliability engineer; both exist in the catalogue.

openDecisions.title: Refresh cadence
openDecisions.question: When do the personas reassess?

options.A: On relevant fact changes, coalesced, plus every 12 hours, within budget

openDecisions.rationale: Fresh after a change, cheap otherwise: about $0.15 a day for two personas, within their weekly allowances.

openDecisions.title: How much the model composes
openDecisions.question: How much of the view may be LLM-composed?

options.B: Assessment on top of facts: callouts, emphasis, ranking, goals, judgement, layer suggestions
options.C: Model-composed view including grouping, order and default layers

openDecisions.rationale: Keeps facts deterministic and comparable while the persona says what matters and what to do next.

# Live structure canvas: machines, containers, semantic zoom, Performance and network layer

Source: `docs/live-structure-canvas/index.html` (AGT-3955) and its chapter pages in the same directory. Read AGENTS.md, frontend/AGENTS.md, docs/quality/design/style-guide-hard-rules.md and docs/system/domains/frontend.md first. Each Dossier recommendation (D1 to D11) is the working decision unless a recorded operator decision selects another option; record the option implemented. Studio tokens and existing components, light and dark, no animation with reduced motion. Fixtures and screenshots use role names only. Workspace data only through the application API; git stays with the platform. One bounded slice.

Dossier pages and sections: `context.html` (Semantic zoom), `layers.html` (Performance and network, Health), `stack.html` (Canvas renderer, Budget), `index.html` (Alternatives, Recommendation), the live `prototype.html`; source `docs/live-structure-canvas/src/engine.js`, `layers.js`, `app.js`.

Builds on AGT-3954 (extended structure endpoint: observed hosts, machine kind and nesting, performance and network facts, deltas). If AGT-3954 is not merged when this starts, consume today's `GET /api/v1/operations/structure` through an adapter that maps it to the Dossier's assumed shape and keeps the 15-second poll; switch to the delta stream when it exists.

## Deliver
1. Port the Dossier engine to typed TypeScript under `frontend/src/app/features/structure/canvas/` (D1 option A): nested layout, camera with wheel, pinch and keyboard, semantic zoom by on-screen size with cross-fade, link bundling to the nearest visible node, static layer cache while the camera moves and crisp redraw on settle, dynamic layer for flow particles, render on demand, pause when the tab is hidden or the canvas is off screen.
2. A lazy standalone `StructureCanvasComponent` mounted with `@defer` and a dynamic import at `#/workspace/operations/structure?view=canvas` (the current view stays default until LSC-4). Minimap, fit, zoom buttons, level 1 to 4 control, search to focus.
3. Layers Performance and network and Health with the Dossier's encodings and legend: CPU, memory, load and slots gauges with warn at 75 % and bad at 90 %; link width and particle density by traffic, dash by link type, latency label, broken down links. Motion levels Lively, Calm, Off (D5); Off with reduced motion.
4. Accessibility: the canvas host is focusable with `aria-activedescendant` pointing into an outline tree that lists every node and link with the facts of the active layers; arrow keys move between nodes, Enter flies to a node, Escape clears.
5. Colours from Studio tokens; the three work-kind colours as new semantic tokens with the validated values of the Dossier.

## Acceptance
- Initial bundle unchanged (build stats compared to develop); the canvas chunk is at most 35 kB gzip.
- Playwright: fixture of the installation (roles only) renders levels 1 to 4; layer toggles; keyboard path; outline equals the canvas; screenshots in both themes at 390 and 1440 px under the results folder.
- Re-run `node docs/live-structure-canvas/bench/run.mjs` on a workstation with a GPU and report pan and zoom fps for candidates A and B; A must reach at least 50 fps with 500 nodes and 2,000 links, otherwise record the fallback to PixiJS behind the same interfaces as a follow-up card.
- With nothing changing, the canvas draws no frame for 5 seconds (frame counter) and no frame while the tab is hidden.

implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Traffic and latency per link

Source: `docs/live-structure-canvas/index.html` (AGT-3955) and its chapter pages in the same directory. Read AGENTS.md, frontend/AGENTS.md, docs/quality/design/style-guide-hard-rules.md and docs/system/domains/frontend.md first. Each Dossier recommendation (D1 to D11) is the working decision unless a recorded operator decision selects another option; record the option implemented. Studio tokens and existing components, light and dark, no animation with reduced motion. Fixtures and screenshots use role names only. Workspace data only through the application API; git stays with the platform. One bounded slice.

Dossier page and section: `stack.html`, Data the layers need (rows Traffic per link, Latency per link).

AGT-3954 delivers performance and network facts per node and links; this slice adds what it does not: bytes per second and latency per link.

## Deliver
1. Host agent: read per-container network counters (cgroup or `/proc/<pid>/net/dev`) and the link forwarder's tunnel byte counters into the existing host report; no packet capture, no extra process.
2. Server: compute rates between reports and attach `bytesPerSec` to each structure link it can attribute; links it cannot attribute report `null`, never zero.
3. Latency: link supervisor heartbeat round trip as `latencyMs` for tunnel and forwarder links; for HTTPS links to outside services the median timing of calls already made (model calls, git pushes, image pulls) over 5 minutes.
4. Contract tests and documentation in the structure endpoint's docs.

## Acceptance
- A fixture host report with counters yields the expected rate; a missing counter yields `null`.
- Host report size grows by at most 1 kB for ten containers; no synthetic probe traffic is added.

Source: `docs/live-structure-canvas/index.html` (AGT-3955) and its chapter pages in the same directory. Each Dossier recommendation (D1 to D11) is the working decision unless a recorded operator decision selects another option; record the option implemented. Workspace data only through the application API; git stays with the platform. One bounded slice.

## Deliver

2. Motion with causes: work tokens hop by hop for coding, gate and review transitions (from task hub events joined with the claiming host); an arc while a deploy step runs (instance deploy records of AGT-3879); restart wash and ring; link-drop ring and broken link; values ease to their new state. - A burst of 50 deltas in one second produces one visual update (counter in a test hook).
- With `prefers-reduced-motion` no animation frame runs and every state change is visible immediately.
- Playwright records the replay of a fixture recording and screenshots a link-down moment in both themes.
